title: Evaluation is All You Need: Strategic Overclaiming of LLM Reasoning Capabilities Through Evaluation Design

bias_targets.methodology: Permuting the order of options in multiple-choice questions (e.g., changing B -> A -> C -> D) in the GPQA Diamond benchmark while keeping the correct answer in a fixed position to measure performance fluctuations.
Systematically placing the correct answer in different option positions (A, B, C, or D) or randomly placing it in the GPQA Diamond benchmark to evaluate if the model favors specific option letters.
